comments.value:
Mute Voice and Mute Avatar as separate options! Yes please!

With visual indicators for both like the current mute indicator!

I'd like this, the ability to only block selected avatars would be amazing as then you can reduce all them sweet draw  calls in a room but still not have to block people.

The block function should imho only be utilized to avoid people you don't want to come in contact with.
This would be way better than blocking. Also, I think players with annoying avatars deserve to know who blocked their custom appearance, in order to avoid confusion.
This is included in the upcoming version of VRChat, v2018.3.2!

details: We have all had the issue were there was 1 person in particular with an avatar that cause us to lag but still enjoy chatting with that particular person. And we don't necessarily want to add everyone or go into safe mode hide avatars. It would be nice to have a toggle in the player menu to disable that players model and replace it with the safe mode avatar.
title: Disable Single player's Avatar
